package.name: acme_rmw
package.description: An out-of-tree RMW provider (RFC-0071 D16, phase-545 W3). It announces `rmw acme` below and declares what it lowers to in the sibling `nros-rmw.toml`. Nothing in the nano-ros tree names it: an image that says `rmw = "acme"` finds it through the provider scan alone.
